mode: Window-free egui, CPU SVG and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Pencil/Brush/Eraser/Line/Rectangle/Ellipse size headers and brush opacity at scales 1/light and 2/dark with repeated layout. Headers have 22-point image bounds, tool-specific accessible names and one tooltip. Header clicks preserve document/history and gesture state; size and opacity values still update actual tool options. Canvas layout stays fixed across tool changes.

icons.scope: Every registered SVG parses and CPU-rasterizes with transparency at 24/64/128 pixels. Existing density and cache bounds pass. Generator rerun leaves SVGs, manifest and gallery byte-identical.

scope: Dedicated original Stroke Size and Opacity SVG symbols replace unrelated brush/blur assets in Classic floating tool panels. Generator/manifest/gallery and asset documentation are updated. Header accessibility labels and tooltips identify the active size setting and brush opacity.
limits: Symbols are original UI illustrations, not captured native artwork or live stroke previews. Brush kernels, gesture semantics, media availability and opacity policy are unchanged. Native/rendered parity and native latency remain unverified.
